[manufacturer] Plumbs Limited — a family-run soft-furnishings company founded in 1953 and headquartered at Brookhouse Mill, Old Lancaster Lane, Preston, Lancashire PR1 7PZ, UK, trading nationwide through www.plumbs.co.uk with made-to-measure sofa covers, curtains, blinds and reupholstery delivered via a free in-home consultation model. The company entered administration on 15 October 2024 (Joint Administrators Sarah O’Toole and Jane Steer, PwC); the majority of the business and assets — including 239 employees — were sold to Sarah Plumb Limited, and the administration concluded on 14 October 2025. The exfiltrated backups are dated June–September 2026.

The captured dataset is the company’s complete file-server and database estate: six shares (E, G, O, P, SQLFilesSage, Shares-Misc) totalling ≈205 GB across 697,364 filesystem entries.

<redacted>

Customer data. O/LIVEDB2 (70 GB, plus an 11 GB duplicate) is the complete RMAN backup set of the production Oracle order/customer database, current to 29 September 2026. G/CallCentre/Extracts contains 873 CSV extracts (2002–2026) whose verified schema is Customer Name, Address, Tel1, Tel2, Mobile, Email Address, Cust No. Shares-Misc/Paragon/Data holds DAILY PLANNING route files for 2017–2026 (customer delivery addresses and slots). Order-level sales with postcodes were verified in G/Finance/Fabric Usage Mar2025.csv (12.6 MB).

Employee and contractor data. G/HR (14 GB) contains Personnel Files including a 768 MB leaver archive, CV’S (164 MB), HR-2025 Updated (3.2 GB), Occupational Health, salaries, P60/P11d, disciplinary toolkits, gender-pay-gap files, and Carl Oracle Info.xlsx — a verified workforce register of Oracle user IDs, initials, full names, departments and payroll numbers. G/Payroll (1.1 GB) holds 2023–2026 payroll reports, Attachment of Earnings, and Driving Licence Checks. P/DSE Assessments contains 118 per-employee health assessment files bearing individual names. G/TDManagement holds current and terminated self-employed Technical Designer records including VAT status and personal purchases.

Financial data. G/Finance (38 GB) includes Bank Statements both (1.7 GB), BACS service forms, a verified BACS payment-run file with payee bank identifiers, supplier payment forecasts with HSBC balances, Customer Accounts Refunds (6 GB of weekly scanned refund packs 2023–2026), Management Accounts (15 GB), budgets 2020–2026, CBILS loan records, credit checks, and the fixed asset register. SQLFilesSage contains the MSSQL 2019 Sage instance directory (system databases and trace logs only; the old PlumbsYe2021.mdf was probed and found to be an empty shell).

Engineering IP. E/Ora_Apps (1.1 GB) is the full source of the Oracle Forms 11g order-processing application (87 MB of converted form XMLs, PLLs, dbforms); G/CAD (14 GB) plus CADUser01–06 profiles and Scratch/CMF Models Finished (195 MB) hold Lectra CAD cutting patterns; Lectra entitlement certificates (GBR-OS1230458/9) and CAD support bundles were verified in Scratch/IT.

Legal and administrative material. G/HR/HMRC holds a multi-year HMRC enquiry file (HMRC 6.5–6.15, information requests and draft responses); G/HR/1. Sarah Plumb Ltd (144 MB) and G/Directors hold administration and sale records; G/Finance/Legal completes the privileged set.

[manufacturer] Fuji Food Products, Inc. (FFP) — a Santa Fe Springs, California-based prepared-foods manufacturer owned by the Meruelo Group, operating since at least the early 2000s, with a sister franchise operation Fujisan Franchising Corp (FFC). The company produces sushi, prepared Asian foods, sauces, dressings, BAO, and gyoza for major US retailers including Kroger, Costco, Sam’s Club, Target, Trader Joe’s, Albertsons/Vons, Stater Bros, WinCo, Food Lion, Aldi, and 70+ additional chains. Owners include Alex Meruelo, Luis Armona, Mario Tapanes, and Rebeca Christy. The company employs an estimated 200–500 people across manufacturing and retail operations in 35+ US states, with annual revenue inferred in the tens of millions from weekly cash receipts of $4–5M. Banking is through East West Bank (6 accounts across both entities), with a Stifel commercial credit facility available.

The exfiltrated dataset totals approximately 227 GB spanning ~298,000 files across 13 departmental shares on the FJSVRFIL Windows file server, capturing the company’s entire operational, financial, and personnel records for both FFP and FFC. The shares include APONLY (51 GB, accounts payable), FDRIVE (73 GB, departmental working files), CHEFONLY (75 GB, store operations and training), ARONLY (39 MB, accounts receivable), ADMONLY (274 MB, corporate administration), ITONLY (29 MB, IT documentation), LGONLY (1.7 GB, legal/operations), LABONLY (1.6 GB, laboratory/QA), QAPRIONLY (23 GB, quality assurance), RDONLY (1.1 GB, R&D formulations), and CFOOnly (32 KB, insurance):

<redacted>

Employee PII and HR data. The ADMONLY share contains scanned passports and driver’s licenses for all 4 company owners (Alex Meruelo NV DL, Luis Armona CDL + passport, Mario Tapanes CDL + passport, Rebeca Christy passport), plus resumes and wire confirmations for share purchases. ITONLY contains 50+ individual employee new-hire PDF files with personal details, roles, and start dates, plus IT Welcome Forms with password policy and VPN/MFA documentation. ADMONLY/BIRTHDAYS holds a 2026 employee birthday list with names and dates of birth. Payroll and labor distribution monthly reports (APONLY) span 2020–2026 for both FFP and FFC, including FICA deferral payment records and manual checks. A 2023 salary history file covers all employees of both entities. 401(k) retirement and payroll SOP records reside in ADMONLY/Corporate Docs. LGONLY/BackUp/Download (1.7 GB, 3,488 files) contains employee performance reviews, accident/first-aid reports for named individuals (D. Garzon, J. Garay, N. Hernandez, T. Martinez, S. Carrillo, E. Reyes), team member warning forms, and W-9 tax documents — an operations manager’s complete working file dump.

Financial and MNPI. The dataset contains the company’s complete financial record: S-Corp tax returns (Form 1120S) for both FFP and Fujisan Franchising Corp from 2020 through 2024; monthly bank reconciliation workpapers and posted reconciliations for 6 East West Bank accounts (FFP accounts ending 6602/6529/6560, FFC accounts ending 36529/35653/35695) from January through August 2026; daily cash balance worksheets tracking Money Market, General Account, and Line of Credit positions; weekly cash sheets showing cash receipts of $4–5M/week, disbursements of $1–3M/week, and intercompany transfers; a fraudulent-check folder with 16 fraud cases spanning 2022–2026 (altered-check attempts involving named vendors/individuals); commission data for 2021–2026 across SUSHI and FRESH HARVEST divisions; AP filing containing 640–716 vendor payment folders per year from 2022–2026 with a W-9 folder and vendor list files; R&D tax credit calculations with payroll registers and W-3 forms; Bank of America corporate credit card statements via Egencia; and Concur trip approvals with FujiHotelConferma virtual-card data. The complete ERP database mirror (501 MB across 16 FoxPro/dBASE DBF files) contains vendor master (4 MB, fields: VENDNO, STATUS, COMPANY, CONTACT, ADDRESS, PHONE), customer master (3 MB, fields: CUSTNO, STORENO, DUNSNO, DIVISION, DISTRICT), AR invoice history (54 MB + 381 MB across both entities), and purchase order history (43 MB) — the company’s entire commercial record from vendor names and contacts to customer-specific pricing and transaction volumes.

Manufacturing intellectual property. The RDONLY share (1.1 GB) contains complete Standard Operating Procedures for every production room — sushi cutting and rolling specifications, sauce formulations (Kung Pao, Korean BBQ, unagi, Honey Garlic, Sesame dressing), BAO and Gyoza production procedures, and FDA/USDA room operations manuals. QAPRIONLY (23 GB) holds the company’s complete HACCP/HARPC food safety plans, ISO 22000/FSSC 22000 certification documentation, and microbiology laboratory SOPs. Customer-specific pricing presentations for 80+ retailers and 40+ executed NDAs with major customers (Kroger, Sam’s Club, Costco, Target, Trader Joe’s, Superior Grocers, and others) are distributed across FDRIVE and CHEFONLY.

Legal and privileged material. LGONLY contains accident reports, employee performance reviews, and disciplinary records for named individuals. ADMONLY holds 40+ executed NDAs spanning vendor, customer, and partner relationships — including agreements with major retailers whose confidentiality clauses are now breached by the exfiltration. Board-adjacent corporate documents including corporate filings, Iron Mountain records management contracts, trademark registrations, and certification records reside in ADMONLY. These files create privilege waiver risk under FRE 502(b).

IT and infrastructure. The DHCP reservation dump (919.csv) maps every device on the internal network — hostnames, IP addresses, MAC addresses, and assigned users across the fujifood.local domain, including FortiAP wireless access points, Polycom VoIP phones, and all employee endpoints. An IP address usage spreadsheet provides additional network topology data. ITONLY contains VPN/MFA configuration documentation, password policy documents, Microsoft Dynamics NAV files, and the Veeam backup license. A domain-name CSV lists 36 domain registrations with account and wallet IDs, renewal dates, and registrar details.

queenslibrary.org Queens Public Library, founded 1896, is a nonprofit serving the most diverse county from 66 locations with 5 million items in 50 languages.
It grew from an 1858 Flushing library and 1896 Long Island charter, merging seven on a 240,000 dollar Carnegie grant from 1901; four survive.CEO Walcott, a schools chancellor, runs 1,400 staff and an unpaid board; FY2026 saw 11.5 million circulations and 6.3 million visits.95 percent of funding is public: 149.9 million for FY2026, 154.1 million for FY2027, and 183.3 million in assets tied to city buildings.A 2014 scandal, when CEO Galante was fired for 670,000 in charges and a rooftop deck while cutting hours, brought city audits and FBI probes.Since 2016 projects like the 41.5 million Hunters Point and 39 million Far Rockaway libraries rebuilt it; 37 projects and 252.5 million unfunded.

steinecke.de Steinecke is a German family bakery group founded in 1945, based in Mariental, Lower Saxony, and run by the third and fourth generation Katrin and Felix Steinecke. It has 500+ branches in six states, three plants (Mariental, Berlin, Bernburg), about 3700 staff and 223 million euro revenue (2024), Germany's largest family owned bakery. Formats include own shops, in store bakeries in REWE, Netto and Marktkauf, railway and cafe sites under Brotmeisterei Steinecke, Ihr Bäcker and Heidebrot Backstube. Around 30 breads, rolls, cakes, snacks and coffee are sold, led by Hausbrot and Heidebrot from an 80 year old sourdough with 24 hour dough rest, baked on stone at nearly 400 degrees. It earned 39 straight DLG quality awards and topped the 2026 German Customer Award. It buys Bio and Fairtrade, uses green power, offsets CO2 and follows supply chain human rights rules. A cyberattack on 15 November 2026 hit its IT, but shops and production kept running.

berkeleyoralsurgery.com Berkeley-Orinda Oral Surgery is a private oral and maxillofacial surgery practice in Berkeley and Orinda, California, operating since the 1950s as one of the longest running oral surgery practices in the East Bay. The team of three to four surgeons, Bryan Krey, Daniel Mobati, Greggory Irving and newcomer Alex Romash, are all board certified in oral and maxillofacial surgery, with founders Richard Berger and Craig Bloom now retired. It covers the full scope of oral surgery, from wisdom teeth removal and dental implants to bone grafting, sinus lifts, facial trauma and corrective jaw surgery, with sedation and general anesthesia performed in the office and 3D cone beam CT imaging on site. The Berkeley office is at 2522 Dana Street Suite 202 with phone 510 848 1055, and the Orinda office at 3 Altarinda Road Suite 208 in the John Muir Health building with phone 925 253 1924, open Monday to Thursday 7 45 to 4 45, Friday 7 to 2, plus one Saturday a month for surgery.

tcindustries.com Revenue $242.9 Million TC Industries is a family owned industrial company founded in 1881, headquartered in Crystal Lake, Illinois, owned by the Berry family since 1935 and run by Bob and George Berry with the fourth generation Bert and Sterling Berry preparing to lead. It is the leading North American maker of cutting edges, wear parts and ground engaging tools for construction, mining and earth moving equipment, and the premier commercial heat treating provider in the region. Key customers are OEM giants Caterpillar, Volvo and Komatsu, and it is the largest independent producer of heat treated cutting edges in the US, Canada and Europe. Four plants in Crystal Lake, Guelph Ontario, Selkirk Manitoba and Skinningrove England employ over 500 people. The one stop shop covers cutting, CNC machining, heat treating, welding, carbide strips, painting and packaging, backed by ISO 9001, 14001 and 17025 certified quality.

arendal.com.mx Revenue $751.1 Million Arendal is a Mexican EPC contractor founded in 1995 in Monterrey, building oil and gas, power, infrastructure and mining projects with its own crews and equipment. It is Mexico's largest pipeline builder and a top two subsea installer in Latin America, with 200 plus projects, a one million pound HDD rig, saturation diving to ADCI and IMCA standards and pipelines moving 3,700 MMscfd of gas. Flagship works include the 452 km 42 inch Los Ramones II Norte gas pipeline with Odebrecht and Techint, Pemex subsea lines in the Bay of Campeche, the El Cuchillo II aqueduct for Monterrey and combined cycle plants up to 600 MW. With subsidiaries HOC Offshore and Arendal HOC Italy it now builds abroad: a 38 inch Vaca Muerta export pipeline in Argentina and a 43 km line for Mellitah in Libya. ISO 9001, 14001 and 45001 certified, 14 million man hours without lost time accidents. Past Pemex contracts have drawn ASF audit scrutiny.

cimmino.com Manifattura Foderami Cimmino is an Italian wholesale fabric distributor based in Naples with roots dating back to 1750, making it one of the oldest textile companies in Europe, now run by the Cimmino family, CEO Fabio Cimmino and CFO Antonio Cimmino. Operating from the CIS Nola wholesale hub, the largest distribution center in Europe, it stocks over 10 million meters of fabric and more than 1,000 fabric types, shipping worldwide within 48 hours through two in house quality labs. Its seven product lines cover linings, ready to wear fashion, bridal and ceremony, dance and events, carnival and party, bed and table linen including the Bellora brand, and upholstery, plus niche church vestment and medical fabrics. Clients include top fashion brands, linen designers and thousands of retailers across Europe, the Americas and Asia, and the company exhibits at Milan Unica and Messe Frankfurt textile fairs. Revenue stands at about 11.6 million euro in 2025 with 31 employees.

New Teeth Now is a dental implant center in Lakeland, Florida famous for same day full mouth restoration, patients leave the same afternoon with a complete set of new teeth. Board certified surgeons Harley Richards and David Kirkpatrick have placed over 30000 implants in 30 years. The specialty is zygomatic implants anchored in the cheekbone for patients with severe bone loss rejected elsewhere, with no bone grafting and an All on X method using four to eight titanium Neodent implants per jaw. All work is under one roof in a 16000 sq ft center with an in house zirconia lab and general anesthesia. Pricing is all inclusive, zygomatic implants cost about 2000 to 4000 dollars each, financing through LendingClub and CareCredit is guaranteed. Patients come from all 50 states and abroad, four clinics in Florida and San Diego. Since 2022 owned by Frontline Dental Implant Specialists, a Leon Capital backed network.
